# Crew dispatch profiles for this home

Scout: `fm-design-config-crew-dispatch-json-profile-04`
Date: 2026-09-15
Deliverable: recommended `config/crew-dispatch.json` for firstmate to install. This scout did not write the live gitignored file.

Captain routing intent (this task): UI / visual design -> Fable family; simpler / routine work -> Sonnet or Grok.

## Recommended `config/crew-dispatch.json`

Install this document as the home's `config/crew-dispatch.json`. It is valid JSON (`jq .` succeeded) and passes the bootstrap `crew_dispatch_validate` checks in `bin/fm-bootstrap.sh` (verified harnesses, effort axes, object-or-array `use`/`default`).

```json
{
  "rules": [
    {
      "when": "The task is UI-facing or visual-design work: frontend styling, layout, HTML/CSS notes chrome, product UI presentation, Lavish artifact design, or a visual review of pages, screenshots, or UI. Includes paper2notes visual HTML notes design. Does not include backend or pipeline work that merely emits images (PDF crop regeneration, classification scripts) unless the task itself is a visual review.",
      "use": [
        {
          "harness": "cursor",
          "model": "claude-fable-5-1-thinking-xhigh"
        },
        {
          "harness": "claude",
          "model": "fable",
          "effort": "xhigh"
        }
      ],
      "why": "Captain: UI/visual/design work routes to the Fable family. Cursor id claude-fable-5-1-thinking-xhigh is this home's proven Book 5 design-overhaul spawn. Claude alias fable at effort xhigh is the same family on the Claude quota window. Cursor has no verified effort flag, so the thinking level is in the model id. Resolve the pair through quota-array-dispatch."
    },
    {
      "when": "The task is simpler or routine: config edits, small targeted fixes, linguist/gitattributes, a thin CI workflow, docs-only copy, status busywork, or a narrow well-specified investigation with an explicit path.",
      "use": [
        {
          "harness": "claude",
          "model": "sonnet",
          "effort": "medium"
        },
        {
          "harness": "cursor",
          "model": "cursor-grok-4.6-high"
        }
      ],
      "why": "Captain: simpler/routine work routes to Sonnet or Grok. Standalone grok CLI is not installed and grok auth is unusable, so Grok is Cursor catalog id cursor-grok-4.6-high. Sonnet is Claude's documented alias so the array spans Claude all_models vs Cursor. Resolve the pair through quota-array-dispatch."
    },
    {
      "when": "The task is substantial non-visual coding or an ambiguous non-visual investigation: multi-file features, pipelines, algorithm or CI-gate work, OCR/intake plumbing, diagnosis or planning scouts that are not a visual review, or Firstmate shared-tooling changes.",
      "use": [
        {
          "harness": "claude",
          "model": "sonnet",
          "effort": "xhigh"
        },
        {
          "harness": "cursor",
          "model": "cursor-grok-4.6-xhigh"
        }
      ],
      "why": "Inferred from this home's backlog, not a captain-stated family change: paper2db pipeline/crop ships, SOTS CI/bench, OCR intake, and firstmate design scouts are common and are not UI design. Keep the captain's Sonnet-or-Grok families at xhigh."
    }
  ],
  "default": [
    {
      "harness": "claude",
      "model": "sonnet",
      "effort": "xhigh"
    },
    {
      "harness": "cursor",
      "model": "cursor-grok-4.6-xhigh"
    }
  ]
}
```

## How firstmate should apply it

1. Copy the JSON above into this home's gitignored `config/crew-dispatch.json`. Do not commit it.
2. At every later crewmate/scout intake, pick the best-fit `when` with judgment (scripts do not match the prose). Resolve a `use`/`default` array through `quota-array-dispatch` (TOON-first `spendPriority` after eligibility, reasoning-class, and runway gates). Pass only concrete `--harness` / `--model` / `--effort` to `bin/fm-spawn.sh`.
3. Cursor profiles omit `effort` on purpose. Cursor has no verified effort flag; bootstrap treats any cursor effort as invalid (`bin/fm-bootstrap.sh` `effort_ok` for cursor is `false`). Thinking level is in the Cursor model id.
4. Do not dispatch `harness: grok`. The standalone Grok CLI is not on `PATH` and `quota-axi auth` reports Grok sign-in unusable. Grok in this file means the Cursor catalog ids `cursor-grok-4.6-*`.
5. Once the file exists, `bin/fm-spawn.sh` refuses any crewmate or scout spawn that lacks an explicit resolved harness. Secondmate homes inherit this file if any are provisioned later. This home currently has no `config/crew-harness` and no `config/crew-dispatch.json`, so every spawn today falls through to firstmate's own runtime (observed: almost all tasks are `harness=cursor`).

## What I did

Read, in this worktree:

- `docs/configuration.md` section "Crew dispatch profiles (config/crew-dispatch.json)" (schema owner, lines 411-454)
- `docs/examples/crew-dispatch.json`
- `AGENTS.md` section 4 (verified harnesses, profile-array resolution, effort fallback)
- `.agents/skills/harness-adapters/SKILL.md` plus `references/common/dispatch.md`, `references/common/model-and-effort.md`, `references/harness/claude.md`, `references/harness/cursor.md`, `references/harness/grok.md`
- `.agents/skills/quota-array-dispatch/SKILL.md`
- `bin/fm-bootstrap.sh` `crew_dispatch_validate()` (lines 1104-1203)

Read from the primary home (named by the brief as useful context; not modified):

- `data/backlog.md`
- `data/projects.md`
- recent `data/*/brief.md` (paper2notes design/CI/LO, paper2db visual review and pipeline, SOTS linguist/tour/blog, this scout and the parallel `fm-crew-dispatch-design-3c` brief)
- `state/*.meta` harness/model fields
- `config/` (only `startup-memory-budget`; no live `crew-dispatch.json` or `crew-harness`)

Discovered live catalogs and quota (2026-09-15):

- `claude --help` / `claude --version` (2.1.272)
- `cursor-agent --list-models` / `cursor-agent --version` (2026.09.10-fd3934a)
- `pi --list-models` (Fable and Sonnet present; not used in the recommended file)
- `which grok` / `grok models` (CLI absent)
- `quota-axi --no-credential-refresh` and `quota-axi auth --json --no-credential-refresh`

Validated the JSON with `jq .` and with the bootstrap validator's `jq` program copied from `crew_dispatch_validate`. Both succeeded.

Did not write `/Users/sinchunyeung/github/firstmate/config/crew-dispatch.json`.

## Schema and resolution (evidence)

`docs/configuration.md` (411-454): optional local gitignored file; `rules[]` of `{when, use, why}` plus optional top-level `default`. `use` and `default` are one profile object or a non-empty array. Every profile needs `harness`. `model` / `effort` / `why` are optional. Firstmate matches `when` with judgment and resolves arrays through `quota-array-dispatch`. Bootstrap validates with `jq`; unverified harness or illegal effort is `CREW_DISPATCH: invalid`.

`AGENTS.md` section 4: verified crew/scout harnesses include `claude`, `codex`, `opencode`, `pi`, `pi-signed`, `grok`, `kimi`, `cursor`, `omp`, plus `muse`, `gemini`, `rovo`, `agy` for crewmate/scout only. Bootstrap's verified list for this file is `claude,codex,opencode,pi,pi-signed,grok,kimi,cursor,agy,muse,rovo,omp` (`bin/fm-bootstrap.sh` 1117). Gemini is not in that bootstrap list; this file does not use it.

Routing precedence: per-task captain override, then best-fit rule, then `default`, then `config/crew-harness`. Effort fallback (when a profile omits it): low for well-understood explicit work, xhigh for ambiguous investigation or design (`harness-adapters` `references/common/model-and-effort.md`). Visual design therefore wants xhigh; Cursor encodes that in the model id.

Every array in the recommended file is an implicit quota-aware choice. Candidates must be on different quota windows when possible. Two Cursor-only models that share `cursor,all_models` would tie on `spendPriority` and escalate. That is why Sonnet is `harness=claude` and Grok is `harness=cursor`, and why Fable is Cursor plus Claude rather than two Cursor Fable ids.

## Catalog evidence (do not infer names)

### Fable

`claude --help` documents alias `fable` and full name `claude-fable-5`:

```
--model <model>  ... alias for the latest model (e.g. 'fable', 'opus', or 'sonnet')
                     or a model's full name (e.g. 'claude-fable-5').
--effort <level> (low, medium, high, xhigh, max)
```

`cursor-agent --list-models` includes (exact lines):

```
claude-fable-5-1-thinking-xhigh - Claude Fable 5.1 1M Extra High Thinking (NO ZDR)
```

This home already spawned the Book 5 design overhaul on that Cursor id. `data/p2n-b5-book-5-both-chapters-design-overhaul-for-a5/brief.md` progress note: "Relaunch with the correct Cursor model id claude-fable-5-1-thinking-xhigh (dots rejected)."

Pi also lists `anthropic claude-fable-5-1`. Not used here: this home's workers are Cursor-primary, and Pi Fable would likely share the Claude quota window with `harness=claude`, which would recreate a same-window tie.

### Sonnet

Claude alias `sonnet` (same `--help` excerpt). Cursor catalog includes `claude-sonnet-5-thinking-high` (already used for `p2n-ci-add-github-actions-ci-workflow-so-pr-che-7f`). The recommended Sonnet candidate is `harness=claude, model=sonnet` so it hits the Claude quota window rather than the tight Cursor `all_models` window.

### Grok

```
$ which grok
grok not found
```

`quota-axi auth --json --no-credential-refresh`: provider `grok` sources `auth-json` missing, `pi:xai` missing. Attention: `grok,all,auth_required,Grok sign-in required (auth unusable)`.

Cursor catalog (exact lines used):

```
cursor-grok-4.6-high - Cursor Grok 4.6
cursor-grok-4.6-xhigh - Cursor Grok 4.6 Extra High
```

`cursor-grok-4.6-medium` also exists. Routine uses `high` rather than `medium` so "simpler" is still a real coding model, matching this home's CI-on-Sonnet-thinking-high bar more closely than a medium Grok. Substantial / default uses `xhigh`, matching recorded metas for LO embeds, OCR intake, and the SOTS draft blog (`model=cursor-grok-4.6-xhigh`).

`harness-adapters` `references/harness/cursor.md`: `harness=cursor` with a `cursor-grok-*` id is Cursor routing Grok, not `harness=grok`.

## Quota snapshot (intake-shaped, 2026-09-15T12:09Z)

`quota-axi --no-credential-refresh` default TOON (abridged):

| provider | scope | remaining | spendPriority | runway |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| claude | all_models | 83% | 0.9443 | through_reset |
| codex | all_models | 100% | 1.0008 | through_reset |
| cursor | all_models | 13% | -1.9515 | projected_exhaustion (~2026-09-17T01:45Z) |
| cursor | grok_bot | 100% | unknown | through_reset |

Attention also flags `cursor,grok_bot,unmeasurable` (blocks spendPriority) and Grok CLI auth unusable.

Consequence for firstmate at the next real intake (re-read TOON then; do not reuse this snapshot):

- Cursor Fable (`claude-fable-5-1-thinking-xhigh`) is `cursor,all_models`: currently overdrawn with projected exhaustion. Runway-feasibility can fail long visual ships.
- Claude Fable (`fable` / xhigh) is `claude,all_models`: healthy, high spendPriority. Likely winner for visual work while Cursor `all_models` stays tight.
- Claude Sonnet is the same healthy Claude window.
- Cursor Grok may bind `cursor,grok_bot` (healthy remaining, unknown spendPriority) rather than `cursor,all_models`. Unknown spendPriority stays eligible; prefer known viable evidence when otherwise comparable, so Claude Sonnet currently outranks Cursor Grok when both pass the other gates.
- Do not add Codex to these arrays. Captain named Fable / Sonnet / Grok, not GPT. Codex is healthy but out of scope for this file.
